name: Riester: the grant is worth more than the deduction
workings: Two children born 2015 and 2018: no childless surcharge, and 0.25 points less care (1.55% as an employee)
Riester grants: 175 basic + 2 × 300 (children born from 2008) = 775. The minimum own contribution is 4% of last year's insured earnings (40,000) less the grants: 825, met by 1325
The deduction saves less than the grant, so it isn't taken
The grant is credited to the contract either way
